help.title: Training
help.body:
Create programs made of several sessions, then start a session to track your sets in real time (weight, reps, rest timer).

The «Generate» button suggests a random program from a short questionnaire (available equipment, goal, experience, time per session). You can regenerate it as many times as you want before saving it, or build a program entirely by hand with «+ Program».

An in-progress session shows up at the top of this tab so you can resume it anytime.

help.title: Profile
help.body:
Your sports ID card: your level per muscle group (Beginner → Elite), computed from your best performances compared to standards by sex and body weight.

You'll also find your progress on the attendance map here, and your unlocked trophies (consistency, muscle progression, equipment specializations...).

In settings (⚙️), you can edit your profile, reset your performances/trophies, or export/import all your data to switch phones.

catalog.title: Exercises
catalog.subtitle: Pick a muscle group to browse the catalog.
catalog.emptyBucket: No exercises in this category yet.

help.title: Exercises
help.body:
Browse the full exercise catalog, organized by muscle group. Each exercise has a page with a demo video, the required equipment, and your performance history (1RM or reps depending on the exercise).

This is where you can check your progress on a specific exercise in detail, regardless of which sessions you practiced it in.

help.title: Attendance
help.body:
A map that gamifies your consistency: your character advances one point each time you finish a session, crossing 6 biomes (Prairie → Valhalla).

If you go too long without training (threshold configurable via the ⚙️ icon top right), your character falls back a whole biome as a penalty.

The total number of sessions done in each biome is shown on your profile, and is never lost, even after a penalty.
